errorCodes.title: Invalid Credentials
errorCodes.description: The email and password combination does not match any account. Double-check your credentials or use the forgot password flow.

errorCodes.title: Email Already Exists
errorCodes.description: An account with this email address already exists. Try logging in instead, or use a different email to register.

errorCodes.title: Phone Already Exists
errorCodes.description: An account with this phone number already exists. Try logging in instead, or use a different number.

errorCodes.title: Contact Phone Already Exists
errorCodes.description: A contact with this phone number already exists on this account. Open the existing contact instead, or use a different number.

errorCodes.title: Account Suspended
errorCodes.description: This account has been suspended by an administrator. Contact support to resolve the suspension.

errorCodes.title: Account Access Denied
errorCodes.description: You do not have permission to access this account. Verify the account ID or request access from the account owner.

errorCodes.title: Token Expired
errorCodes.description: Your access token has expired. Use your refresh token to obtain a new access token, or log in again.

errorCodes.title: Token Invalid
errorCodes.description: The provided token could not be validated. Clear your stored tokens and log in again.

errorCodes.title: Token Missing
errorCodes.description: This endpoint requires authentication. Include a valid Bearer token in the Authorization header.

errorCodes.title: Account Header Missing
errorCodes.description: Account-scoped requests authenticated with JWT require the X-Account-Id header. Use GET /accounts to list accessible accounts, or include the header from the frontend client state.

errorCodes.title: Refresh Token Invalid
errorCodes.description: The refresh token is invalid, has been revoked, or has expired. Log in again to obtain new tokens.

errorCodes.title: Email Already Verified
errorCodes.description: This email address has already been verified. No further action is needed.

errorCodes.title: Email Verification Code Invalid
errorCodes.description: The email verification code is incorrect. Check the code and try again, or request a new one.

errorCodes.title: Email Verification Code Expired
errorCodes.description: The email verification code has expired (codes are valid for 15 minutes). Request a new verification code.

errorCodes.title: Email Verification Code Used
errorCodes.description: This email verification code has already been used. Request a new code if you need to verify again.

errorCodes.title: Email Service Unavailable
errorCodes.description: The email delivery service is temporarily unavailable. Retry your request in a few moments.

errorCodes.title: Phone Already Verified
errorCodes.description: This phone number has already been verified. No further action is needed.

errorCodes.title: Phone Verification Code Invalid
errorCodes.description: The phone verification code is incorrect. Check the code and try again, or request a new one.

errorCodes.title: Phone Verification Code Expired
errorCodes.description: The phone verification code has expired (codes are valid for 10 minutes). Request a new verification code.

errorCodes.title: Phone Verification Code Used
errorCodes.description: This phone verification code has already been used. Request a new code if you need to verify again.

errorCodes.title: Phone Number Missing
errorCodes.description: No phone number is associated with this account. Add a phone number before attempting verification.

errorCodes.title: SMS Service Unavailable
errorCodes.description: The SMS delivery service is temporarily unavailable. Retry your request in a few moments.

errorCodes.title: MFA Already Enabled
errorCodes.description: Multi-factor authentication is already enabled on this account. No further setup is needed.

errorCodes.title: MFA Not Enabled
errorCodes.description: Multi-factor authentication is not enabled on this account. Call the MFA setup endpoint first.

errorCodes.title: MFA Not Setup
errorCodes.description: MFA setup has not been initiated. Call the MFA setup endpoint to receive a TOTP secret before verifying.

errorCodes.title: MFA Code Invalid
errorCodes.description: The MFA code is incorrect or has expired. Enter the current code from your authenticator app.

errorCodes.title: Password Reset Token Invalid
errorCodes.description: The password reset token is invalid or corrupted. Request a new password reset email.

errorCodes.title: Password Reset Token Expired
errorCodes.description: The password reset token has expired (tokens are valid for 1 hour). Request a new password reset email.

errorCodes.title: Password Reset Token Used
errorCodes.description: This password reset token has already been used. Request a new password reset email if needed.

errorCodes.title: Current Password Incorrect
errorCodes.description: The current password you provided is incorrect. Try again with the correct password.

errorCodes.title: Password Same As Current
errorCodes.description: Your new password must be different from your current password. Choose a different password.

errorCodes.title: Invalid OAuth State
errorCodes.description: The OAuth state parameter is invalid, expired, or missing. Restart the OAuth flow from the beginning.

errorCodes.title: OAuth Provider Error
errorCodes.description: The OAuth provider (e.g., Google) returned an error during authentication. Try again, or check the provider's status page.

errorCodes.title: OAuth Already Linked
errorCodes.description: This OAuth account is already linked to a different user. Unlink it from the other account first, or use a different OAuth account.

errorCodes.title: Provider Already Connected
errorCodes.description: You already have this OAuth provider connected. Unlink the existing connection before linking a new one.

errorCodes.title: OAuth Not Linked
errorCodes.description: No OAuth connection exists for this provider on your account. Link the provider first before attempting to unlink.

errorCodes.title: Cannot Unlink Only Auth Method
errorCodes.description: This is your only authentication method. Set a password or link another OAuth provider before unlinking this one.

errorCodes.title: Validation Failed
errorCodes.description: One or more request fields failed validation. Check the errors array in the response for field-specific details.

errorCodes.title: Bad Request
errorCodes.description: The request is malformed or contains invalid parameters. Check the request body and query parameters.

errorCodes.title: Invalid JSON
errorCodes.description: The request body is not valid JSON. Ensure the body is properly formatted and the Content-Type header is application/json.

errorCodes.title: Resource Not Found
errorCodes.description: The requested resource does not exist or has been deleted. Verify the resource ID.

errorCodes.title: Not Found
errorCodes.description: The requested resource does not exist or has been deleted. Verify the resource ID.

errorCodes.title: Forbidden
errorCodes.description: You do not have permission to perform this action. Contact the account owner for access.

errorCodes.title: Insufficient Permissions
errorCodes.description: Your role does not have sufficient permissions for this action. Contact your organization owner or admin.

errorCodes.title: Conflict
errorCodes.description: The request conflicts with the current state of the resource. Fetch the latest state and retry.

errorCodes.title: Resource Already Exists
errorCodes.description: A resource with these properties already exists. Use a different identifier or update the existing resource.

errorCodes.title: Insufficient Balance
errorCodes.description: Your account balance is too low for this operation. Add funds from the billing page to continue.

errorCodes.title: Payment Required
errorCodes.description: This feature requires payment. Add a payment method and ensure your account has sufficient balance.

errorCodes.title: Subscription Required
errorCodes.description: An active subscription is required for this feature. Upgrade your plan to access it.

errorCodes.title: Feature Not Available
errorCodes.description: This feature is not included in your current plan. Upgrade to a higher tier to access it.

errorCodes.title: Payment Failed
errorCodes.description: The payment charge failed (card declined, insufficient funds, or payment processor error). Try a different payment method.

errorCodes.title: Business Rule Violation
errorCodes.description: The request violates a business rule. Check the error detail for specifics.

errorCodes.title: Invalid State Transition
errorCodes.description: This state transition is not allowed from the resource's current state. Check the resource status before retrying.

errorCodes.title: Unprocessable Entity
errorCodes.description: The request is well-formed but cannot be processed. Check the error detail for the specific reason.

errorCodes.title: Rate Limit Exceeded
errorCodes.description: Too many requests. Wait for the duration specified in meta.retryAfterSecs before retrying.

errorCodes.title: Queue Full
errorCodes.description: The call queue has reached maximum capacity. Wait for active calls to complete before queuing more.

errorCodes.title: Assistant Quota Exceeded
errorCodes.description: Your assistant usage allowance for this period is exhausted. It resets at meta.resetsAt; topping up your balance also earns extra assistant allowance.

errorCodes.title: Phone Verification Required
errorCodes.description: Your phone number must be verified before claiming this promotion. Verify your phone in profile settings first.

errorCodes.title: Payment Method Required
errorCodes.description: A payment method on file is required before claiming this promotion. Add a card in billing settings first.

errorCodes.title: Trial Already Claimed
errorCodes.description: The trial credit has already been claimed for this user. It can only be claimed once.

errorCodes.title: Promotion Not Eligible
errorCodes.description: This promotion cannot be claimed with the provided details. Contact support if you believe this is an error.

errorCodes.title: Coupon Not Found
errorCodes.description: No coupon exists with this code. Check the code for typos.

errorCodes.title: Coupon Not Redeemable
errorCodes.description: This coupon is no longer redeemable — it is inactive, outside its redemption window, or fully redeemed.

errorCodes.title: Coupon Already Redeemed
errorCodes.description: You have already redeemed this coupon. Each coupon can be redeemed once per user.

errorCodes.title: Phone Number Not Active
errorCodes.description: This phone number is not in active status. Activate the phone number from your dashboard before using it for calls.

errorCodes.title: Phone Number Not Verified
errorCodes.description: This phone number must be verified before making outbound calls. Complete the verification process first.

errorCodes.title: Phone Number Cannot Initiate Calls
errorCodes.description: This phone number can only receive calls. WhatsApp numbers do not support outbound calling yet — choose a phone number with outbound call capability.

errorCodes.title: Flow Not Published
errorCodes.description: The flow must be published before it can be used for calls. Publish the flow from the flow editor.

errorCodes.title: Provider Call Rejected
errorCodes.description: The telephony provider rejected the call to this number. The destination may not be enabled for outbound calling from this account.

errorCodes.title: Concurrent Call Limit Exceeded
errorCodes.description: You have reached the maximum number of simultaneous active calls for your account. Wait for active calls to end or upgrade your plan.

errorCodes.title: Daily Call Limit Exceeded
errorCodes.description: Your daily call quota has been exhausted. The limit resets at midnight UTC, or upgrade your plan for higher limits.

errorCodes.title: Contact On DNC List
errorCodes.description: This phone number is on your account's Do Not Call list. Remove it from the DNC list before calling, or skip this contact.

errorCodes.title: Outside Callable Hours
errorCodes.description: This call was blocked because the recipient's local time is outside legal calling hours (8 AM–9 PM). Schedule the call for an appropriate time.

errorCodes.title: Call Already Completed
errorCodes.description: This call has already ended and cannot be modified. Fetch the call details to see the final status.

errorCodes.title: Phone Provider Not Active
errorCodes.description: The phone provider is not in active status. Activate the provider before using its phone numbers.

errorCodes.title: Phone Number Already Connected
errorCodes.description: This phone number is already connected to a flow. Disconnect it from the current flow before connecting to a new one.

errorCodes.title: Phone Number Not Connected
errorCodes.description: This phone number is not connected to any flow. Connect it to a flow to enable inbound call handling.

errorCodes.title: Provider Must Be SIP
errorCodes.description: This operation is only available for SIP-type providers. Verify the provider type before proceeding.

errorCodes.title: Verification Only For SIP
errorCodes.description: Caller ID verification is only supported for SIP phone numbers. System Twilio numbers are verified automatically.

errorCodes.title: Phone Verification Not Started
errorCodes.description: No caller ID verification is in progress for this number. Start a new verification before checking the status.

errorCodes.title: Twilio Credentials Required
errorCodes.description: Twilio account credentials (Account SID and Auth Token) are required for this provider type. Provide them in the request.

errorCodes.title: BYOC Only
errorCodes.description: This operation is only available for BYOC (Bring Your Own Carrier) providers. It does not apply to system Twilio numbers.

errorCodes.title: Phone Already Registered
errorCodes.description: This phone number is already registered in the system. Use a different number or check existing phone numbers.

errorCodes.title: Cannot Delete System Provider
errorCodes.description: System-managed providers cannot be deleted. Only user-created SIP and BYOC providers can be removed.

errorCodes.title: Flow Name Already Exists
errorCodes.description: A flow with this name already exists in your account. Choose a different name.

errorCodes.title: Flow Structure Invalid
errorCodes.description: The flow definition contains structural errors. Check the errors array in the response for specific node and edge issues.

errorCodes.title: Flow Has Connected Phones
errorCodes.description: This flow cannot be deleted because phone numbers are still connected to it. Disconnect all phone numbers first.

errorCodes.title: Flow Version Invalid
errorCodes.description: The flow version format is invalid. Use semantic versioning format (e.g., 1.0.0).

errorCodes.title: Flow Version Conflict
errorCodes.description: The flow has been modified since you last loaded it. Fetch the latest version and try again.

errorCodes.title: Flow Function Name Already Exists
errorCodes.description: A flow function with this name already exists in your account. Choose a different name.

errorCodes.title: Flow Function Not Found
errorCodes.description: No flow function was found with this ID. Verify the function ID or list functions to find the correct one.

errorCodes.title: Flow Generation Failed
errorCodes.description: The AI could not produce a valid flow from this description. Rephrase the request with a clearer goal, or build the flow manually in the editor.

errorCodes.title: Payment Method Card Only
errorCodes.description: Only card payment methods are currently supported. Add a credit or debit card to proceed.

errorCodes.title: Template Variable Resolution Failed
errorCodes.description: One or more template variables could not be resolved. Ensure all required variables are provided in the request.

errorCodes.title: Phone Number In Use
errorCodes.description: This phone number is already in use by another user. Use a different phone number.

errorCodes.title: MFA Token Invalid
errorCodes.description: The MFA token is invalid or has expired. Log in again and complete the MFA challenge.

errorCodes.title: Invalid ID Format
errorCodes.description: The provided ID is not a valid UUID. Use the format xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx.

errorCodes.title: Verification Code Invalid
errorCodes.description: The verification code is incorrect. Check the code and try again, or request a new one.

errorCodes.title: Cannot Delete Has Dependencies
errorCodes.description: This resource has dependent resources that must be removed first. Check which resources reference it before deleting.

errorCodes.title: Schedule Not Found
errorCodes.description: No call schedule was found with this ID. Verify the schedule ID or list schedules to find the correct one.

errorCodes.title: Schedule Already Paused
errorCodes.description: This schedule is already paused. No action is needed, or resume it before pausing again.

errorCodes.title: Schedule Not Paused
errorCodes.description: This schedule is not paused and cannot be resumed. Only paused schedules can be resumed.

errorCodes.title: Invalid Cron Expression
errorCodes.description: The cron expression is malformed. Use standard 5-field cron syntax (minute hour day month weekday).

errorCodes.title: Invalid Timezone
errorCodes.description: The timezone identifier is not recognized. Use a valid IANA timezone (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/Istanbul).

errorCodes.title: Campaign Not Found
errorCodes.description: No campaign was found with this ID. Verify the campaign ID or list campaigns to find the correct one.

errorCodes.title: Campaign Not In Draft State
errorCodes.description: This campaign is not in draft state and cannot be modified. Only draft campaigns can be edited.

errorCodes.title: Campaign Has No Contacts
errorCodes.description: This campaign has no contacts to call. Add contacts before starting the campaign.

errorCodes.title: Legal Acceptance Required
errorCodes.description: You must accept the required legal documents (Terms of Service, Privacy Policy) before proceeding.

errorCodes.title: Invitation Not Found
errorCodes.description: The invitation does not exist or has already been accepted, declined, or revoked.

errorCodes.title: Invitation Not Pending
errorCodes.description: This invitation has already been accepted, declined, or revoked. It can no longer be acted upon.

errorCodes.title: Invitation Expired
errorCodes.description: This invitation has expired and is no longer valid. Ask the organization admin to send a new invitation.

errorCodes.title: Not Invitation Recipient
errorCodes.description: This invitation was sent to a different user. Only the intended recipient can accept or decline it.

errorCodes.title: Organization Suspended
errorCodes.description: This organization is suspended and cannot accept new members. Contact the organization owner.

errorCodes.title: Already Organization Member
errorCodes.description: This user is already a member of the organization. No invitation is needed.

errorCodes.title: API Key Invalid
errorCodes.description: The API key is not recognized or has been deleted. Create a new API key from your dashboard.

errorCodes.title: API Key Expired
errorCodes.description: This API key has passed its expiration date. Create a new API key to restore access.

errorCodes.title: API Key Revoked
errorCodes.description: This API key has been revoked and can no longer be used. Create a new API key if needed.

errorCodes.title: API Key Not Allowed
errorCodes.description: API key authentication is not permitted on this endpoint. Use a JWT Bearer token instead.

errorCodes.title: API Key Insufficient Scope
errorCodes.description: This API key does not have the required scope for this operation. Create a new key with the appropriate scopes, or use a JWT.

errorCodes.title: API Key IP Restricted
errorCodes.description: The request IP address is not in this API key's allowed IP list. Update the key's IP restrictions or use a different key.

errorCodes.title: API Key Limit Reached
errorCodes.description: You have reached the maximum number of API keys for this account. Delete unused keys before creating new ones.

errorCodes.title: Internal Server Error
errorCodes.description: An unexpected server error occurred. If this persists, contact support with the requestId from this response.

errorCodes.title: Service Error
errorCodes.description: An external service dependency encountered an error. Retry your request in a few moments.

errorCodes.title: Service Unavailable
errorCodes.description: The service is temporarily unavailable. Retry your request in a few moments.

errorCodes.title: No Bots Available
errorCodes.description: No healthy bots are currently available in the target region to handle this call. Retry shortly while the bot pool scales up.

errorCodes.title: Region Saturated
errorCodes.description: The target region is at capacity (bot pool plus queue is full). Retry in a moment, or contact support if this persists.

errorCodes.title: Recording Not Available
errorCodes.description: No recording is available for this call. The call may not have been recorded, or the recording has been deleted.

errorCodes.title: Recording Service Not Configured
errorCodes.description: Recording storage is not configured on this deployment. Contact your administrator to enable recording.

errorCodes.title: Meta Integration Not Configured
errorCodes.description: The Meta (Facebook) integration is not configured on this deployment. Contact your administrator to enable it.

errorCodes.title: Page Already Connected
errorCodes.description: This Facebook page is already connected to an account. Disconnect the existing integration first, or pick a different page.

errorCodes.title: Form Already Mapped
errorCodes.description: This lead form already has a mapping on the integration. Update or delete the existing mapping instead.

errorCodes.title: Meta API Error
errorCodes.description: Meta's API rejected the request. Check the integration status and re-connect if the page tokens have expired.

errorCodes.title: Meta Lead Unrecoverable
errorCodes.description: This lead can't be retried. It was submitted without a valid phone number, so re-fetching it from Meta won't help.

errorCodes.title: Unauthorized
errorCodes.description: This endpoint requires authentication. Include a valid Bearer token or API key in your request.
